entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, this is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet. Just need the label.
Absolutely, I can help with that. To pull up your order, could I get your name or order number?
Order is VF1138-9. Can you just send the label? I'm in a hurry.
Understood. One moment... Okay, I see the AeroPro helmet, delivered six days ago. I do need to ask, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference. The color is off, it doesn't match my bike. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched it.

Not a problem at all. We definitely want you to be happy with the color and, more importantly, your safety on the road. Since it's a standard helmet and you're well within the 90-day return period, I can approve this return for a full refund right now.
Okay, so you're sending the label?

Yes. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on file. And, since I see you're a VIP member with us, I've also gone ahead and added complimentary expedited shipping to your VeloFit account for your next order. No code needed, it will apply automatically.
Oh. That's actually useful. I see the email just came through. Thanks, that was fast.
We appreciate your business. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride.
